intervention_description: Integrated resilience program combining food assistance for assets (FFA), lean season support, nutrition/health services, school feeding, and market support

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Cash transfers provided through FFA and lean season support
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Nutrition supplements and health screenings provided
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Community asset creation through FFA activities
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Agricultural and market support training included
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Community asset creation and group activities mentioned

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite score measuring dietary diversity and food consumption frequency
outcomes.literal_text: Improvements in food security are observed for the Food Consumption Score (FCS) at endline, which increases by 1.5 points

outcomes.outcome_description: Scale measuring household food insecurity experiences
outcomes.literal_text: The coefficient for FIES is 0.24, from a comparison mean of 1.83 -a relative increase of 13.1 percent (significant at the 10 percent level)

outcomes.outcome_description: Total annual household consumption in local currency
outcomes.literal_text: The programme also increased total consumption, partly driven by an increase in food consumed from households' own production, and partly by an increase in food purchased

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of households with wage employment
outcomes.literal_text: There were increases in the percentage of households with wage employment (by 10 percentage points)

outcomes.outcome_description: Value of farm assets in local currency
outcomes.literal_text: Farm asset value increased by FCFA 3,833.2*
The share of households that own livestock increased by 9 percentage points

outcomes.outcome_description: Hectares of land cultivated by household
outcomes.literal_text: The area cultivated also increased by 0.27 hectares

outcomes.outcome_description: Number of people household could ask for money
outcomes.literal_text: Number of people you could ask for money increased by 0.597***
